Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class PidNativeControlSystem

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.PidNativeControlSystem
public final class PidNativeControlSystem extends Object
Imports, configures and verifies actual native control-system instrumentation in a canonical P&ID.

The source process is authoritative for hardware and causal object identity. The canonical proposal governs complete supported PID/anti-surge policy, instrument signal settings and native valve hydraulics/travel. Generic safeguarding proposals are not promoted to physical objects. This is an automation-engineering simulation handoff, not a safety PLC, vendor machinery-protection package, installed independence assessment or construction approval.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
